title: Melt your circuit boards
summary: mitxela shows his KiCad plugin that rounds PCB tracks to give circuit boards organic, melted-looking layouts instead of rigid geometric ones.
why: Recommended as a great creative PCB-design video and linked in threads on KiCad and artistic boards.

quote.text: mitxela did a great video on this topic recently and wrote a plugin for kicad to make the regular geometric layouts more organic.
